== Biography ==

== Trivia ==
* His ID '''Bin''' is based on his given name (Ze-Bin).
* Considered to be the best {{ci|irelia}} player in solo queue.
* His father also played League of Legends and used to call up Bin to carry him.
* Went to the same high school as [[JackeyLove]].
* Famous for his {{ci|gangplank}} game-winning play against [[G2 Esports]] in a group tiebreaker during [[Worlds 2020]].
* First and only player to achieve a pentakill in Worlds Finals.
* Known as a player with biased champion pool. He is pretty good playing as divers, such as {{ci|irelia}}{{ci|Fiora}} and {{ci|Camille}}. However he is bad playing as tanks such as {{ci|Ornn}} and {{ci|Sion}}, while he holds a very low win rate with those champions.
* Before being a professional player, he was a fan of [[RNG]].
** It was revealed in a video comment on Bilibili during the 2018 postseason after [[Invictus Gaming]] won the World Championship, saying "I am still waiting for RNG." (我还在等RNG).<ref>https://www.bilibili.com/video/BV1Dt411y7EZ?</ref>
=== Statistics ===
* Reached 1000 kills in the LPL on June 1, 2023.
** The 39th player and 5th toplaner (after [[Flandre]], [[TheShy]], [[369]] and [[Breathe]]) to reach 1000 kills in the LPL.
* Reached 1500 kills in the LPL on March 22, 2025.
** The 26th player and 3rd toplaner (after [[Flandre]] and [[369]]) to reach 1500 kills in the LPL.
* Reached 300 wins in the LPL on January 25, 2025.
** Was the 22nd player to reach 300 wins in the LPL.
* Reached 500 games in the LPL on April 5, 2025.
** The 32nd player to reach 500 games in the LPL.
* Reached 600 games in the LPL on September 7, 2025.
** The 23rd player to reach 600 games in the LPL.
* Reached 500 international kills during [[2025 Mid-Season Invitational|MSI 2025]] on July 11, 2025 in Lower Bracket Round 3, becoming the 8th player to achieve this milestone after [[Faker]], [[Perkz]], [[xiaohu]], [[Caps]], [[Maple (Huang Yi-Tang) | Maple]], [[GALA]], and [[Gumayusi]].
* Reached 3000 assists in the LPL on August 06, 2025.
** Was the 40th player to reach 3000 assists in the LPL.
=== Individual Awards ===
* First Stand Finals MVP x1 (2026)
* LPL 1st All-Pro Team x4 (Summer 2023, Spring 2024, Summer 2024, Split 2 2026)
* LPL 2nd All-Pro Team x2 (Summer 2021, Split 1 2026)
* LPL Finals MVP x2 (Spring 2022, Split 1 2026)
